motions.motion: Councilmember Burnham moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing the Disposal of Significant City-Owned Real Property Pursuant to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 3.30 and using the price of the land at $45,000 per acre ($1.03 per square foot) nothing the parcel does not require additional water rights. motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing the Disposal of Significant City-Owned Real Property Pursuant to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 3.30 and directed Staff to work on refining water requirements and draft a policy to ensure consistent review of future Land Disposal Applications
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to table a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing the Disposal of Significant City-Owned Real Property Pursuant to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 3.30 and directed Staff to work on refining water requirements and draft a policy to ensure consistent review of future Land Disposal Applications. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: failed for lack of a majority vote, 2:3.
